summary: Synthetic source inventories distinguish broad tracker groups, bounded assignments, mechanical batches, a small cohesive change, and interaction, reuse, and specialist-capability decisions.
planted: Localization has heterogeneous source sizes, shared writes, independent translation preparation, and downstream uncertainty.
A mechanical field migration has a compatible transition and separate consumer checks rather than user-facing slices.
A single-message repair has no useful parallel boundary.
Synthetic capability descriptions, some suitable and some not, stand in for a host's skill list; they do not prove native discovery.
Maintained and legacy compositions, a duplicated composition, a requirement the maintained composition cannot meet, partial design, and a product choice presented as an algorithm.
A settled one-string interaction change and a non-interface task with specialist capabilities listed.
Paired date-entry requirements distinguish a sufficient native input from a maintained calendar needed for disabled-day display.
A delegate's rental-extension permission reveals a later additional-charge payer choice; its recommendation is not an accepted answer.

An asynchronous product question remains pending after supported independent preparation is exhausted; safe waiting depends on usable actual host controls, otherwise an incomplete response preserves the resume condition.
A course-time edit affects existing registrations, reminders, and calendar promises; an engineer's preservation recommendation does not settle the owner's material alternative.
The owner explicitly selects a fully prepared collection-label subset while the rental-extension decision remains pending.
A reviewed small confirmation-copy record has no open product choice, workflow selection, or useful orchestration boundary.
setup: Use the existing capture preparation path to copy the fixture into an owned isolated session.

Keep the evidence and selected owner prompt identical across arms. Do not create an application to turn this planning instrument into an implementation test; the capability lists are text, not installed skills.
run_checks: none; grade the returned plan against the selected section of evidence.md
privacy: All inventories, counts, and application details are invented.
